biography:
CloudHQ designs, builds and operates mission critical data centers for customers who typically are among the largest internet companies in the world. We are a technology company first and our team has hundreds of years of collective technical expertise and operational experience. As a privately held organization, we're uniquely able to maintain our customer focus and deliver best-in-class data centers with unparalleled speed and agility.
 
As a result, CloudHQ is one of the fastest growing hyperscale data center providers in the world - with 12 campuses spanning four continents currently under active development and more to follow.

My role includes full life cycle real estate development management for existing campus expansions, as well as new campuses located across numerous US states, countries and continents. I also help manage corporate government relations, policy, and strategy across our various markets.
